newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 sharply higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 sharply higher in late trading.

text.p: April 15 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures recovered from day session lows to drift back to the top half of the day's range. Traders said the market shrugged off tech sector weakness and rebounded nicely from the 749.50 day session low after T-bonds closed. One broker said market prone to shortcovering bounces after recent weakness. Volume moderate.
